description: The Norwegian Centre for Climate Services is the national portal for climate knowledge for adaptation. The home page read on 2026-09-28 offers estimated climate change towards 2100, weather observations with history and time series, design rainfall values (intensity-duration-frequency curves) for dimensioning drainage, county climate profiles and a test version of municipal climate profiles to be completed in December 2026, grouped by precipitation, flood, temperature, landslides, snow and sea. It also holds reports such as Klima i Norge, the 2024 sea level report on rise and extremes and Klima på Svalbard 2100, and links to hazard maps for flood and landslides and to sea level and snow services. Coverage is Norway and Svalbard. Access is free on the web; the home page states no licence. Caveats: the page is script heavy, and the formats of the underlying projection data were not checked from the cloud session. It supports climate adaptation studies of infrastructure, such as choosing design rainfall and future climate factors for stormwater pipes and culverts. No related Norwegian climate service record is catalogued.
